title: Apple outage: iPhone apps suffer disruption days after major Microsoft issues
paragraphs: Thousands reported disruptions to Google’s Gmail and Apple’s iPhone apps, such as Apple Pay and iCloud, on Tuesday, according to Downdetector. Apple confirmed the outages in a statement but said it had resolved them, while Google said it had not seen internal signs of outages.
Apple’s own system status page as of 2.30pmET showed problems with services such as the App Store, iCloud Mail, iCloud Web Apps and AppleCare.

“Many of our systems are back up and running after an internal update caused some outages this morning. We’re working to get the remaining systems online as soon as possible,” an Apple spokesperson said.
